name: popsicle
headline: Rajdeep Das Internships: Portfolio & Credentials
short_description: Rajdeep Das | Internship Completion tracks & records of all earned Certificates, LOR, LOA, Credits or perks. Done internships both in Technical & No-technical fields. Being a part of Technical side like Web-Dev/Cloud DevOps, also co-co-worked for a long time in Digital Marketing & content writing field.
author: Rajspeaks

sections.overview:
This skill provides access to a comprehensive internship portfolio documenting Rajdeep Das's professional experience across technical and non-technical fields. The repository includes internships completed at major organizations like General Motors Technical Centre India, PayNearby, MapMyIndia, and virtual programs through Forage partners including Microsoft, Goldman Sachs, and Deloitte. It serves as a centralized record of certificates, letters of recommendation, and credentials earned through hands-on roles in web development, cloud DevOps, digital marketing, and content writing. The resource is useful for professionals tracking their own internship documentation, those evaluating internship programs, or anyone building a comprehensive career record.
Portfolio building and credential tracking across multiple internships
Documenting technical internships in cloud, DevOps, and web development
Recording non-technical roles in digital marketing and content writing
Organizing certificates and letters of recommendation from major tech companies
sections.setup:
No install command available. Check the GitHub repository for manual installation instructions.
`git clone https://github.com/Rajspeaks/Rajdeep-Das-Internships`
sections.usage:
```
Create a detailed internship completion report for [STUDENT_NAME] who completed an internship at [COMPANY] in the [INDUSTRY] field. Include certificates earned, letters of recommendation, credits, and any perks received. Highlight both technical and non-technical skills developed during the internship.
```
